subsidiary: ceat, asset_id: ceat.finished_tyre, lifespan_category: Tyre Mileage Lifespan, baseline_design_life: 60000, unit: km, typical_time_horizon: 48 Months, underlying_physics: Archard abrasive tread contact wear + mechanical carcass fatigue under internal pressure cyclic flexing., failure_modes: trigger_condition: bulge, rul_remaining_pct: 0.0, rul_display: 0 km (Scrap Mandated), risk_level: Critical, wear_index: 1.0, maintenance_action: Immediate tyre quarantine & scrap per CEAT QC-TY-02 / ISO 10191. High carcass blowout hazard., projected_end_of_life: Immediate Replacement Required, trigger_condition: bead_damage, rul_remaining_pct: 0.0, rul_display: 0 km (Rim Breach Hazard), risk_level: Critical, wear_index: 1.0, maintenance_action: Quarantine tyre. Discard from service., projected_end_of_life: Immediate Replacement Required, trigger_condition: cut, rul_formula: round(max(0.12, 1.0 - (0.35 + defect_area_ratio * 4.0)) * 100, 1), risk_level: High to Moderate, maintenance_action: Dismount tyre for ultrasonic ply-breaker inspection. Quarantine from steer axles., projected_end_of_life: Prognostic limit dependent on cut depth, trigger_condition: uneven_wear, rul_remaining_pct: 54.0, rul_display: 32,400 km / ~27 Months, risk_level: Moderate, wear_index: 0.46, maintenance_action: Perform chassis wheel alignment and rotate tyre diagonally to equalize treadwear., projected_end_of_life: Estimated service limit at +32,400 km, trigger_condition: nominal_sound, rul_remaining_pct: 92.5, rul_display: 55,500 km / ~46 Months, risk_level: Low, wear_index: 0.075, maintenance_action: Maintain 32-34 PSI cold inflation pressure; rotate at standard 10,000 km maintenance interval., projected_end_of_life: 46 Months remaining (Standard Service)

subsidiary: harrisons, asset_id: harrisons.smoked_sheet, lifespan_category: Storage Shelf-Life (Green Book), baseline_design_life: 24.0, unit: months, typical_time_horizon: Warehouse Storage, underlying_physics: Microbial biodegradation and atmospheric oxidation of cis-1,4-polyisoprene polymer matrices., failure_modes: trigger_condition: mould, rul_formula: max(0.5, 6.0 - (defect_area_ratio * 50.0)) months, risk_level: Critical (<2 months) or High (<6 months), maintenance_action: Immediate hot-smoke shed re-drying (<60°C) with thymol sanitization. Package with moisture-barrier film., projected_end_of_life: 14 Months remaining before tensile loss, trigger_condition: nominal_sound, rul_remaining_pct: 95.0, rul_display: 22.8 Months (Premium Quality), risk_level: Low, wear_index: 0.05, maintenance_action: Standard dry palletized storage; certified for export compounding without restrictions., projected_end_of_life: 22+ Months remaining (Full Grade 1 Life)
